flagged.evidence: The title says “The discrete L-curve rule terminates and selects a maximum-curvature grid point.” For the admissible input A=[0], b=0, and grid 1<2<3, every residual and solution norm is zero, so all points are discarded and the algorithm returns failure. The Statement confirms failure when fewer than three valid points remain; the title’s unconditional selection claim is false.
